en: Commentaries on the Dharma-character School (Hossō-shū):
Compiled by Imperial Decree for the Great Dharma Master Heihaku of Tōdai-ji,
*An Explanation of the Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra*, three fascicles, composed by Daśabala Śrīmitra (Jōkei).
*Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Xuánjì* (Profound Record of the Diamond Sutra), ten fascicles; composed by Jì. *Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Shū* (Commentary on the Diamond Sutra), two fascicles;

composed by Jì. *Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Xuányǎn* (Explication of the Diamond Sutra), three fascicles; composed by Dàoyīn. *Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Shū* (Commentary on the Diamond Sutra), three fascicles; composed by Huángguāng.
*Jīngāngbōrě Nènduàn Shùzàn* (Eulogy on the Commentary of the Diamond Sutra that Decisively Severs), three fascicles; composed by Yuǎnxiao.
Xuánfàn’s *Commentary on the Diamond Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra* in two fascicles; Jìngmài’s *Commentary on the Benevolent Kings Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra* in three fascicles;
Yuáncè’s *Commentary on the Benevolent Kings Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra* in two fascicles; Huìjìng’s *Commentary on the Benevolent Kings Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra* in two fascicles;
Xuánfàn’s *Commentary on the Benevolent Kings Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra* in three fascicles; and Liángbēn’s *Principle of Prajñā* based on the newly translated [text].
*The Exposition of the Ratnaguṇasaṃcayagāthā*, three fascicles, by Jñānagarbha; *The Profound Commentary on the Prajñāpāramitā-naya-prakāśa*, one fascicle, by Jñānagarbha;
*The Profound Commentary on the Heart Sūtra*, one fascicle, by Yijing; *The Commentary on the Heart Sūtra*, one fascicle, by Jñānagarbha;
*The Commentary on the Heart Sūtra*, one fascicle, by Paramārtha; *The Commentary on the Heart Sūtra*, one fascicle, by Jñānacakra; [and] *The Commentary on the Heart Sūtra*, by Jingmai.
*Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra-ṭīkā*, fourteen fascicles, composed by Jingxing; *Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra-ṭīkā*, ten fascicles, composed by Songxu;
*Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra-artha-ṭīkā*, five fascicles, composed by Yiji; *Saṃdhinirmocana-sūtra-ṭīkā*, eleven fascicles, composed by Lingyin;
*Saṃdhinirmocana-sūtra-ṭīkā*, ten fascicles, composed by Yuanze; *Saṃdhinirmocana-sūtra-ṭīkā*, three fascicles, composed by Xuanguan.
Wonhyo composed the *Fahua xuanzan* (Profound Commentary on the Lotus Sutra) in ten fascicles; Woncheuk composed the *Fahua shuzan* (Commentary and Praise on the Lotus Sutra) in ten fascicles;

Huining composed the *Fahua shu* (Commentary on the Lotus Sutra) in eight fascicles; Xuanguan composed the *Fahua shu* (Commentary on the Lotus Sutra) in seven fascicles; Daorong composed the *Fahua yijue* (Resolution of Doubts on the Meaning of the Lotus Sutra) in one fascicle;

Huizhao composed the *Fahua sheishi* (Compendium and Explanation of the Lotus Sutra) in four fascicles; and Zhi Zhou composed the *Fahua juezeji* (Record of Determinations on the Lotus Sutra) in eight fascicles.

*Fahua hongzan* (Extensive Praise of the Lotus Sūtra) in twelve fascicles, composed by Quan Chongjun; *Zuishengwang jing shu* (Commentary on the Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra) in six fascicles, composed by Xinghe;

*Zuishengwang jing luezan* (Brief Praise of the Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra) in twelve fascicles, composed by Huizhao; *Zuishengwang jing shu* (Commentary on the Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra) in eight fascicles, composed by Jingxing;
*Shengman jing shu* (Commentary on the Śrīmālā-sūtra) in one fascicle, composed by Yuanxiao; *Shengman jing shu* (Commentary on the Śrīmālā-sūtra) in two fascicles, composed by Jingmai.
*Commentary on the Twelve-Gate Dhāraṇī Sūtra*, one fascicle, composed by Wonhyo; *Commentary on the Bhaisajyaguru Sūtra*, one fascicle, composed by Jingxing;
*Commentary on the Eleven-Faced Avalokiteśvara Sūtra*, one fascicle, composed by Jingmai; *Commentary on the Ullambana Sūtra*, one fascicle, composed by Huizhao;
*Commentary on the Maitreya’s Ascent to Tuṣita Sūtra*, two fascicles, composed by Huijing; *Commentary on Maitreya’s Ascent to Tuṣita*, composed by Kuiji.
*Jing-sū* (Commentary on the Sūtra), two fascicles, composed by Jingxing; *Mile chengfo jing-sū* (Commentary on the Sūtra of Maitreya’s Attainment of Buddhahood), one fascicle, composed by Huijing;
*Pusa zang jing-sū* (Commentary on the Bodhisattvapiṭaka Sūtra), ten fascicles, composed by Jingmai; *Fangwang jing-sū* (Commentary on the Brahmajāla Sūtra), two fascicles, composed by Yiji;
*Fangwang jing guji* (Ancient Traces of the Brahmajāla Sūtra), two fascicles, composed by Zhizhou; and *Liumen tuoluoni* (The Six-Gate Dhāraṇī), [fascicles], composed by Taixian.
*Commentary on the Bhikṣuṇī Sūtra*, one fascicle; authored by Ji. *Commentary on the Vimalakīrti-nirdeśa Sūtra*, six fascicles;
authored by Ji. *Commentary on the Vimalakīrti Sūtra*, six fascicles; authored by Xuánfàn. *Commentary on the Aparimitāyur-jñāna Sūtra*, three fascicles;
authored by Yuáncè. *Commentary on the Sukhāvatīvyūha Sūtra*, one fascicle; authored by Yìjì. *Essentials of the Western Paradise*, [one fascicle]; authored by Jìngmài.
*Jue* (Decisions), one fascicle; *Daśacakrakṣitigarbha-sūtra-ṭīkā*, two fascicles, composed by Daechi;
*Laṅkāvatāra-sūtra-vyākhyā*, seven fascicles, composed by Wönhyo; *Uṣṇīṣavijayā-dhāraṇī-sūtra-maṇivana*, one fascicle, composed by Haenggan;
*Anūnatvāpūrṇatvanirdeśa-sūtra-vyākhyā*, one fascicle, composed by Wönhyo; *Jentaka-sūtra-vyākhyā*, one fascicle, composed by Hyejong. These have already been recorded.
*Shang Dacheng jing shu* (Commentary on the Mahāyāna Sūtras), [author unknown].
*Yujia lun chao* (Excerpts from the Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra), sixteen fascicles, composed by Ji. *Yujia lun shu* (Commentary on the Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra), twenty-five fascicles, composed by Zhenkong.
*Yujia lun shu* (Commentary on the Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra), thirteen fascicles, composed by Wenbei. *Yujia lun shu* (Commentary on the Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra), thirty-six fascicles, composed by Jingfa.
Master [Xuanzang] composed the *Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra* (in four fascicles on reality); Yuanxiao composed the *Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra-jì* (twenty-four fascicles);
Dunlun composed the *Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra-jí* (ten fascicles); Fuqiu composed the *Bǎifǎlùn xuànzàn* (one fascicle);
Ji composed the *Bǎifǎlùn shù* (one fascicle); Dachengguang composed the *Bǎifǎlùn shù* (one fascicle); and Yuance composed [the same].
*Śatadharma-śāstra-vyākhyā*, ten fascicles, composed by Sōhō; *Śatadharma-śāstra-ṭīkā*, seven fascicles, composed by Genjō;
*Pañcaskandha-prakaraṇa-vyākhyā*, one fascicle, author unknown (lost in the East); *Prakaraṇāryavāca-śāstra-vyākhyā*, eight fascicles, composed by Kyōkō;
*Prakaraṇāryavāca-śāstra-vyākhyā*, ten fascicles, five hundred and eighty sheets, composed by Chijin; *Mahāyānasaṃgraha-ṭīkā*, ten fascicles, composed by Kiki.
*Shè dàchéng lùn shū* (Commentary on the *Mahāyānasaṃgraha*), eleven fascicles, composed by Dharma Master Kuò; *Shè dàchéng lùn shū*, ten fascicles, composed by Shéntài;
*Shè dàchéng lùn shū*, seven fascicles, composed by Píbálá; *Shè dàchéng lùn zhāng*, five fascicles, composed by Xuànfàn;
*Shè dàchéng lùn yìjué* (Decisions on the Meaning of the *Mahāyānasaṃgraha*), seven fascicles; *Ābhidharmasamuccaya*.

*Shu ji lun chao* (Commentary on the *Mahāyānasaṃgraha-bhāṣya*), seven fascicles, composed by Ji; *Fajie wucheng shilun shu* (Commentary on the *Dharmadharmatāvibhaṅga*), ten fascicles, composed by Xuanguan;

*Fajie wucheng shilun shu* (Commentary on the *Dharmadharmatāvibhaṅga*), sixteen fascicles, composed by Lingjun; *Bian zhongbian lun shu* (Commentary on the *Madhyāntavibhāga*), three fascicles, composed by Ji;

*Bian zhongbian lun shu* (Commentary on the *Madhyāntavibhāga*), six fascicles, composed by Xuanguan; *Bian zhongbian lun shu* (Commentary on the *Madhyāntavibhāga*), three fascicles, composed by Huizan.
*Commentary on the *Viṃśatikā-vijñaptimātratāsiddhi-śāstra* in two fascicles (175 sheets), composed by Wonhyo;

*Commentary on the *Viṃśatikā-vijñaptimātratāsiddhi-śāstra* in two fascicles, composed by Woncheuk; *Commentary on the *Vijñaptimātratāsiddhi-śāstra* in ten fascicles (630 sheets), composed by Woncheuk;
*Essentials of the *Vijñaptimātratāsiddhi* in two fascicles, composed by Woncheuk; *Separate Extracts from the *Vijñaptimātratāsiddhi* in five fascicles, composed by Woncheuk.
*Weishi shu* (Commentary on the *Vijñaptimātratāsiddhi*), ten fascicles, composed by Yuan Ce; *Weishi shu*, four fascicles, composed by Hui guan;

*Weishi liao yi deng* (Lamp for the Definitive Meaning of the *Vijñaptimātratāsiddhi*), seven fascicles, composed by Hui zhao; *Weishi yao ji* (Essential Compendium of the *Vijñaptimātratāsiddhi*), thirteen fascicles, composed by Fang; *Weishi yao ji*, fourteen fascicles, composed by Dao zheng;

*Weishi bian liang* (Critical Evaluation of the *Vijñaptimātratāsiddhi*), twenty fascicles, composed by Jing xing; *Weishi jie jie* (Section-by-Section Explanation of the *Vijñaptimātratāsiddhi*), three fascicles.

*Weishi yanshu* (An Elucidation of the Secrets of Consciousness-Only) in seven fascicles, composed by Kuoshu; *Weishi yiyan* (An Elucidation of the Meaning of Consciousness-Only) in thirteen fascicles, composed by Zhizhou;

*Weishi tanwei chao* (A Draft on the Subtleties of Discourse on Consciousness-Only) in twenty fascicles, composed by Ruli; *Weishi weixiang jue* (Decisions on Unclear Points in Consciousness-Only) in two fascicles, composed by Ruli;

*Weishi yuzu* (Wings for Consciousness-Only) in four fascicles, composed by Yiji; and *Weishi taichao* (The Great Draft on Consciousness-Only) in twenty-four fascicles. *Weishi* [is the title of the root text].

*Dongchao* (Eastern Commentary), three fascicles; *Weishi Beichao* (Northern Commentary on the Treatise on Consciousness-Only), three fascicles; *Nanzhichao* (Commentary on Difficult Points), five fascicles;

*Weishi Yiyun* (The Essence of the Meaning of Consciousness-Only), ten fascicles—composed by Daoyong of Kaiyuan Temple; *Da zhuangyan lun shu* (Commentary on the Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra), ten fascicles—composed by Huijing;
*Guansuo yuan yuan lun shu* (Commentary on the Ālambanaparīkṣā), two fascicles—composed by Ce; *Guansuo yuan yuan lun shu* (Commentary on the Ālambanaparīkṣā), one fascicle—composed by Shenkuo.
*Yuan yuan lun shu* (Commentary on the *Ālambanaparīkṣā*), one fascicle, composed by Shentai. *Guansuo yuan yuan lun shu* (Commentary on the *Ālambanaparīkṣā*), one fascicle, composed by Ji.

*Zong lun lun shu* (Commentary on the *Samayabhedoparacanacakra*), one fascicle, forty-one pages, composed by Ji. *Fo di lun shu* (Commentary on the *Buddhabhūmi-śāstra*), six fascicles, composed by Jingmai.

*Fo di lun shu* (Commentary on the *Buddhabhūmi-śāstra*), four fascicles, composed by Zhiren. *Foxing lun shu* (Commentary on the *Foxing lun*), four fascicles, composed by Dharma Master Bian. *Guang* [Commentary], extensive.
*Commentary on the Śataśāstra*, ten fascicles; *Exhaustive Exposition of the Commentary on the Tattvasiddhi-śāstra*, two fascicles, composed by Jingmai;
*Exhaustive Exposition of the Commentary on the Tattvasiddhi-śāstra*, two fascicles, composed by Shentai. The above are commentaries on Mahāyāna treatises.
The *Abhidharmakośa-bhāṣya-ṭīkā* in fifteen fascicles, divided into thirty fascicles, composed by Puguang;

the *Abhidharmakośa-bhāṣya-ṭīkā* in twenty fascicles and nine hundred and ninety-nine sheets, composed by Shentai; the *Abhidharmakośa-kārikā-vyākhyā* in six fascicles (also titled *Kārikā-ṭīkā*), composed by Yuanhui;
the *Vibhāṣā-śāstra-ji* in ten fascicles; and the *Vibhāṣā-śāstra-ṭīkā* in fourteen fascicles, composed by Jingda.

*Shunzhengli-lun-shu* (Commentary on the *Nyāyānusāra-śāstra*), twenty-four fascicles, eight hundred and thirty sheets, composed by Yuanyu; *Tianqin-pusa-zhuan* (Biography of Bodhisattva Vasubandhu), one fascicle, composed by Tripiṭaka Master Paramārtha;
*Daci-xiyu-ji* (Great Tang Records on the Western Regions), twelve fascicles, composed by Tripiṭaka Master Xuanzang;
*Daci'en-si-san-zang-zhuan* (Biography of the Tripiṭaka Master of the Great Ci'en Monastery), ten fascicles, composed by Huili; *Huirilun* (Treatise on the Sun of Wisdom).

*Fayuan zhijue* (The Essential Meaning of the Dharma Garden), four fascicles, composed by Huizhao; *Fayuan jueze ji* (Records of the Decisions on the Dharma Garden), two fascicles, composed by Qingsu;
*Shuyao ji* (Records of the Pivot), four fascicles, composed by Zhizhou; *Liaoyi deng ji* (Lamp of the Definitive Meaning), one fascicle, composed by Yibin;

*Zhongxing chabie ji* (Collection on the Distinctions of Spiritual Lineages), three fascicles, composed by Zhizhou; *Dacheng fayuan linyang zhang* (Treatise on the Forest Chapters of the Mahāyāna Dharma Garden), seven fascicles, composed by Fang; totaling two hundred [fascicles].

*Ji-shu Shichishūken-shō* (Twenty-seven Chapters on the Sages), one fascicle, ninety-nine sheets; authored by Ji. *Shi-shu Shōron Jukyugi-shō* (Ten Chapters on the Ten Categories of the Vaiśeṣika), one fascicle; authored by Ji.

*Ji-shu Jōdaijigi-rinshō* (Twelve Chapters on the Forest of Meanings of the Mahāyāna), twelve fascicles; authored by Ji. *Gijaku-shu Rokujūni-ken-shō* (One Chapter on the Sixty-two Views), one fascicle;

authored by Enzoku. *Enzoku-shu Nyūdō-shō* (One Chapter on Entering the Path), one fascicle; authored by Enzoku. *Chishū-shu Jū-in Shiyen Go-in* (Ten Causes, Four Conditions, and Five Causes), authored by Chishū.
*Zhang* (Chapters), one fascicle, thirty-three sheets; *Wen Beishu Daopin Zhang* (Chapter on the Exposition of the Path Factors by Wen Bei), one fascicle, seventeen sheets;

*Shentai Shu Dasheng Sishangen Zhang* (Shentai’s Exposition on the Four Degrees of Heat in the Mahāyāna), one fascicle, fourteen sheets; *Shentai Shu Yuanhong Shi Zhang* (Shentai’s Exposition on Master Yuanhong), four fascicles, one hundred and twenty sheets;
*Zongfa Shi Zhang* (Chapter on Master Zongfa), four fascicles; *Erzhang Zhang* (Chapter on the Two Obstructions), one fascicle; *Sanzhang Zhang* (Chapter on the Three Obstructions), one fascicle.

The scroll contains one chapter in eighteen pages; the *Jiandao zhang* (Chapter on Seeing the Path) in one scroll; the *Dacheng wufa zhang* (Chapter on the Five Dharmas of Mahāyāna) in one scroll in thirty-six pages;
the *Zashi nan zhang* (Chapter on Miscellaneous Difficulties) in one scroll in twenty-eight pages; the *Manzhi sihuo zhang* (Chapter on the Four Delusions of Manas) in one scroll in eleven pages;
the *Buke zhang* (Supplementary Chapter) in three scrolls; and the *Pusa di shifa zhang* (Chapter on the Ten Dharmas of the Bodhisattva Stage) in one scroll in six pages.

The *Guanzhang* (Chapter on Contemplation), one fascicle and eight sheets or more, was composed by the Great Tang Patriarch. The *Yanshenzhang* (Chapter on Investigating the Spirit), five fascicles, was composed by Huming.

The *Fayuanlinzhangji* (Record of the Chapter on the Forest of the Garden of Dharma), three fascicles, was composed by Huming. The *Fenliangjue* (Decision on Quantities), one fascicle, was composed by Shanzhu. The *Mingdengchao* (Excerpts from the Bright Lamp), twelve fascicles, was composed by Shanzhu. The *Fayuanlinzhangji* (Record of the Chapter on the Forest of the Garden of Dharma), one fascicle, was composed by Shanzhu. The *Liaoyidengji* (Record of the Lamp of Definitive Meaning), one fascicle, was composed by Shanzhu. The *Liaoyidengji* (Record of the Lamp of Definitive Meaning), one fascicle, was composed by Changteng. The *Fayuanlinzhangji* (Record of the Chapter on the Forest of the Garden of Dharma), one fascicle, was composed by Pingbei.
